sara (People Ops): quick question — our Q4 sick pool looks underfunded after a couple of long LOAs on platform. Can we approve emergency allocations for teams that are exposed? Need to know: 1) manager request flow, 2) whether carryover or special pro-rate applies for folks returning from LOA, and 3) payroll cutoff implications. cc @elaine :thinking:
elaine (HRBP): thanks for flagging. we do have an emergency sick top-up policy but it's handled case-by-case. managers submit a request to people-ops@redwood.com with dates + headcount impact. LOA returners usually keep their accrued balance but we can pro-rate a one-time exception if there's a clear gap. :white_check_mark:
raj (Eng Manager): we have 2 ICs and 1 EM out on LOA — coverage hit is causing repeated oncall swaps. can managers approve bridge-day swaps in the short term or do we need central sign-off?
luis (Payroll): payroll note — any one-time top-ups must be submitted before the payroll adjustment cutoff: 2188514400 (payroll team uses that timestamp internally). after that it's next cycle. also provide employee IDs in the request so we can apply adjustments cleanly.
sara (People Ops): proposed flow: manager files request -> people ops triage -> if approved, HRBP signs off on eligibility -> payroll applies one-time credit. I can draft a short request template. any objections? :memo:
raj (Eng Manager): sounds good. template would help. can we add a field for expected coverage days lost and impact on SLAs? helps prioritize. :+1:
elaine (HRBP): include LOA dates, expected return date, and whether the person is eligible under our LOA retention policy. we'll evaluate pro-rate against their tenure and reason for LOA.
peopleops-bot: Reminder: people-ops request template and policy link — https://redwood-internal/hr/policies/emergency-sick-topup — please attach in your ticket.
sara (People Ops): ok i'll post the template in this thread and open a central tracker. action items: 1) raj to send manager request email by EOD with IDs, 2) sara to post template + tracker, 3) elaine to review eligibility when submitted. will also confirm whether bridge-day swaps need exec approval and report back. thanks everyone :pray:
raj (Eng Manager): sending now. thanks all.
